title: Filing Complaints with the State Commission

content.scenario: A consumer, Rohan, purchases a product worth Rs. 5 crore, but the product is defective. He wants to file a complaint against the manufacturer. He files a complaint with the State Commission, as the value of the goods or services paid as consideration exceeds Rs. 1 crore but does not exceed Rs. 10 crore.
content.outcome: The State Commission may entertain the complaint and pass an order, as per the provisions of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: How to file a complaint with the State Commission?
What is the jurisdiction of the State Commission?
Can a complaint be filed against a manufacturer for a defective product worth more than Rs. 1 crore?
